description: Intensive week program covering the fundamentals of Salesforce B2C Commerce and the SFRA framework.

Comprehensive courses on building complex applications with Java EE, J2EE Patterns, Spring MVC Web Applications, Spring Boot, Spring Batch, Hibernate, Oracle11g PL/SQL, Microservices, REST, JavaScript and HTML5&CSS3.
Project: Design and implementation of a Java EE Web application with MVC architecture, for PDF generation of electronic tickets.
Project: Design and implementation of a .NET Web application with MVC architecture for the exchange of experiences and resources of the In-TIC project.
